== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Avernus]] [[Travelers]] are individuals belonging to the [[Avernus]] [[Territory]], a realm characterized by massive forests and an abundance of avian life. These [[Travelers]] are often associated with birds, frequently accompanied by flocks or large creatures such as white eagles and ravens. Some members of this group possess the ability to summon these animals through specific methods, such as using a whistling sound or specialized items like feathers. While some [[Travelers]] rely heavily on their supernatural abilities, certain [[Avernus]] members are noted for being practically prepared for physical combat. In terms of social structure, [[Avernus]] [[Travelers]] often prioritize tribal affiliations over national loyalties. They are led by a Grandmaster, such as [[Grandmaster Avernus]], and may serve under various Overlords. The process of [[Traveling]] through the [[Avernus]] [[Territory]] is described as difficult and time-consuming, lacking the precision found in other regions. Additionally, many [[Travelers]] within this group share a deep connection to their avian companions.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The [[Avernus]] [[Travelers]] are women characterized by their brown buckskin clothing and the feathers worn in their hair. During a nearby battle, these travelers surrounded [[Kai]] as combat unfolded. While many of the group perished following the fighting, those who maintain connections among the [[Sarin]] serve as highly effective spies.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Avernus]] [[Travelers]] are a specific classification of traveler. In an effort to bring them together, Feiora seeks to unify their ranks. Some individuals from this group were even utilized as borrowed personnel for [[Cana]]. While they often wear armored black outfits and maintain a unique bond with their birds, these travelers may also suffer from an arrogant reliance on their own powers.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Feiora seeks to unify the [[Avernus Travelers]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c4">''City of Light'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Some of the personnel borrowed from [[Cana]] were [[Avernus Travelers]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c7">''City of Light'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
